sentences.en: She twisted a strand of hair around her finger.
sentences.zh: 她用手指缠绕了一缕头发。

sentences.en: He plucked one of his few strands of beard.
sentences.zh: 他拔掉了自己稀疏胡子中的一缕。

sentences.en: Sami was stranded on a remote island in the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 萨米被困在了太平洋的一个偏远岛屿上。

senses.zh: 使搁浅；使陷于困境；弄断；使落后 -
